description: This file defines error types, error variables, and utility functions for error handling within the 'model' package of the focalboard server, including custom error types, error creation functions, and error type checking functions.

classes.name: ErrNotFound
classes.description: Error type representing a not found error for a specific entity.

classes.name: ErrNotAllFound
classes.description: Error type indicating not all resources of an entity were found.

classes.name: ErrBadRequest
classes.description: Error type for malformed or invalid API requests.

classes.name: ErrUnauthorized
classes.description: Error type for unauthorized access attempts.

classes.name: ErrInvalidCategory
classes.description: Error type for invalid category errors.

methods.name: IsErrBadRequest
methods.description: Checks if an error is or wraps a bad request error.

methods.name: IsErrUnauthorized
methods.description: Checks if an error is or wraps an unauthorized error.

methods.name: IsErrForbidden
methods.description: Checks if an error is or wraps a forbidden error.

methods.name: IsErrNotFound
methods.description: Checks if an error is or wraps a not found error.

methods.name: IsErrRequestEntityTooLarge
methods.description: Checks if an error is or wraps a request entity too large error.

methods.name: IsErrNotImplemented
methods.description: Checks if an error is or wraps a not implemented error.
